answerable_log.answer: A data structure is a way to organize and manage data efficiently, enabling systems to track and manipulate information effectively. In the context of operating systems, data structures like the process list are critical for managing running programs and their states. They allow the OS to keep track of all active processes, determine which process is currently executing, and handle resource allocation and scheduling

What is the role of the immune system?
answerable_log.answer: The immune system's role involves both innate nonspecific host defenses and adaptive specific host defenses to protect the body from pathogens. Innate defenses provide immediate, non-specific protection, while adaptive defenses involve specialized cells like T and B lymphocytes to target specific pathogens [p.17][p.18].
